Jordan / team / Melanie —

Rough engineering plan and constraints below (high level, available for a quick call if you want deeper ops sizing):

- Provisioning lead time: 6-8 weeks for a fully isolated APAC VPC with 2 initial clusters (we run a pre-provision validation, networking peering/failover checks, and an audit window). If they accept our standard network templates it can be 6 weeks; custom firewall/NAT rules stretch to 8.
- Baseline sizing: recommend 2 x rtx-6000-equivalent clusters (redundant masters) to support peak user loads for the pilot. Burst runway: ability to add 2 more worker groups in 48 hours with reserved spot/burst capacity.
- Dependencies: standard SOC2 artifacts we require (we can provide from our pack) plus customer to provide network CIDR ranges, acceptance test endpoints, and an owner for SRE runbooks.
- Priority capacity SLO: With a 24-month committed uplift (20% baseline commit increase) we can promise Q1 priority scheduling for cluster expansion windows and a 10% unit-price discount for token/ingestion units.

I attached a baseline "SOA-Audit-Checklist.xlsx" and a simplified network diagram stub that shows the peering flows — these will help procurement/security triage.

If procurement wants formal wording for the SLA/credit for capacity failure, we should loop Legal but can propose a carveout clause in the term sheet.

Kimberly Park
Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
